verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a built-in agent, Spark, that handles information synthesis and can take natural-language actions through connectors, such as creating and updating Linear issues and acting in Slack. However, evidence of in-product task delegation is limited to marketing one-liners, and the MCP server evidence concerns external agents, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on Spark's delegable task scope within Productboard data, documented in-app task execution or approval workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Productboard's built-in agent handles all the information synthesis
Create & update Linear issues from Spark, check backlogs, project progress, and more.
